propositions: Auto-derive a caused_by link at bug close by git-blame of the pre-fix state, resolving the dominant culprit commit via its rebar-ticket: trailer, only when > 50% of blamed lines across file_impact point to one commit.
The explicit --caused-by <id> parameter overrides auto-derivation and always sets the caused_by link regardless of blame ambiguity.

The auto-derived caused_by link must bypass the closed-source guard on _links.add_dependency by writing directly via _write_link_event, since the bug is already closed after txn.transition_core commits.
Ambiguous blame (no file_impact, no fixing commit, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable trailer) results in no auto-link; only strict single-culprit cases auto-link.
The public library facade transition() in _lib_writes.py must thread caused_by as a keyword parameter to transition_compute so library callers can set caused_by on close.
The bug-template must include a blame-hunt advisory documenting when auto-derivation applies and when to use --caused-by manually.
